How it works

Add a nested tag such as #learning/science/physics to a note. Open FilePrint: Open fingerprint from the command palette, or use the ribbon icon.

FilePrint follows the note you open. The selected tag controls the sound and visual family; the note’s title, path, and supported metadata also affect visual details.

To show a fingerprint inside a note, insert a fileprint code block. Press Play sound to start a loop. Audio never plays automatically.

Runs on your device

The plugin generates visuals and audio locally. No account, API keys, telemetry, or runtime network requests. It does not scan your whole vault or create generated files.

FilePrint is free and available under the MIT license.

Installation

Early release · v0.1.0

FilePrint is not yet listed in Obsidian’s Community Plugins directory. Install it manually using the three files from the same release or source build.

  1. Create this folder inside your vault:
    .obsidian/plugins/fileprint/
  2. Copy main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css into the folder.
  3. Reload Obsidian and enable FilePrint under Settings → Community plugins.
